caveats: No relay reports delivering this block hash: privately built / vanilla (non-MEV-Boost) block, or the delivering relay no longer serves this slot.
Losing bids: relays expose only block_hash/num_tx/gas_used/value for builder_blocks_received, never the transactions, so `contains_focus_txs` is `unknown` for every bid except the winning block hash.
Bid timestamps are each relay's own receive clock (ms); t_rel_slot_ms is relative to slot start (genesis+12*slot). Cross-relay comparison carries the relays' clock skew and network latency.
